name: Collection Pathauto
description: Collection submodule: prepends a canonical collection's URL alias to the Pathauto alias of the content it collects.
project_description: Submodule of Collection that integrates with Pathauto. When a collected content entity's canonical collection item is set, its Pathauto alias is prefixed with the URL alias of that collection (e.g. my-blog/post/title). It also provides a hook_collection_pathauto_alias_alter() so other modules can further modify the combined alias, and regenerates the collected entity's alias when it is removed from a collection or is no longer canonical.
